subtitle: Master guitar techniques through real songs and musical contexts. Learn why, when, and how to apply each technique.

columns.title: Musical Context
columns.text: Understanding when and why techniques are used in real music makes practice more meaningful and memorable.

columns.title: Progressive Learning
columns.text: Each technique is taught through carefully selected songs that demonstrate its musical application and benefits.

topics.title: Rhythm Guitar Techniques
topics.description: Master strumming patterns, muting, and chord transitions that drive songs forward.
topics.context: Essential for rhythm parts in pop, rock, and folk music

topics.title: Lead Guitar Techniques
topics.description: Develop picking techniques, bending, and vibrato for expressive melodic playing.
topics.context: Critical for solos, fills, and melodic lines

topics.title: Fingerpicking Patterns
topics.description: Learn classical and contemporary fingerpicking approaches for acoustic songs.
topics.context: Perfect for acoustic ballads and fingerstyle arrangements

topics.title: Percussive Techniques
topics.description: Add rhythmic percussion to your playing with palm slaps and body percussion.
topics.context: Modern acoustic and percussive guitar styles

topics.title: String Bending & Vibrato
topics.description: Master expressive techniques that bring emotion and character to your playing.
topics.context: Essential for blues, rock, and expressive lead playing

topics.title: Advanced Picking
topics.description: Explore hybrid picking, sweep picking, and economy picking for complex passages.
topics.context: Technical passages in progressive and metal genres

topics.title: Slide & Legato
topics.description: Create smooth, connected phrases using slides, hammer-ons, and pull-offs.
topics.context: Smooth melodic lines and bluesy expressions

topics.title: Effects Integration
topics.description: Learn how technique changes when using distortion, delay, reverb, and modulation.
topics.context: Modern electric guitar tones and textures

steps.title: Foundation
steps.description: Start with picking patterns and basic strumming to build your rhythmic foundation.

steps.title: Expression
steps.description: Add bending, vibrato, and hammer-ons to make your playing more expressive.

steps.title: Advanced
steps.description: Master sweep picking, tapping, and other advanced techniques for complex passages.

infoSections.title: Practice Tip
infoSections.content: Focus on one technique at a time, but always practice it within the context of complete musical phrases or song sections. This helps you understand how the technique serves the music, not just the technique itself.
